proposal.statement: Procedure for producing a defensible verified-slice knowledge artifact in this workspace's RC10 validation flow, as demonstrated by the independently verified S01 evidence: (1) when the frozen test suite fails at a seeded contract defect (missing openSelectedChart export), obtain execution evidence by directly importing the ES modules at the pinned revision (confirm with git rev-parse HEAD = 2eff5f9f84ca709684bfe0b7c90102268f07a0f0, then node --input-type=module), recording exact commands and outputs as new observation evidence records; (2) upgrade to VALIDATED only the claims independently executable this way (select-chart, render-chart, HTTP 404 non-retryable), never by source count alone and never with an unrelated pre-existing seed as substitute evidence; (3) keep seeded conflicts (chartLimits max=10 vs code=1000; missing openSelectedChart export) unadjudicated as PROVISIONAL [Gap/CONFLICTING]; (4) bind every revision to a fresh archive digest and rerun all affected independent Reviewer/Verifier gates on that digest, with no silent store edits and honest reporting of failures (stale validator stdout corrected by fresh capture); (5) on elapsed-time boundary, stop new dispatch without killing in-flight children; reconcile notification failures as notification-only, never fabricating replacement verdicts.
